CareCoordinate — Family Caregiving App for Medications, Appointments & Shared Care

# A family caregiving app for the 63 million Americans coordinating someone’s care

— built by two of them

From Andy & Adam Arthur Ford LLC

CareCoordinate isn’t an app that’s just another asset for a large corporate entity. It isn’t a hastily thrown together app using AI. It was carefully crafted by Andy, an extremely detail-oriented Software Architect, and Adam, a long term caregiver with a passion for organization.

We also happen to be spouses caring for a loved one, along with our family members. After decades of experience, we know the stress of being responsible for getting it all right. We understand the nuances and complications. And we quickly realized the power of AI to surface the work to be done, and organize it as quickly as possible.

CareCoordinate is an innovative app built on and powered by Anthropic Claude. We designed with compassion in mind and imbued it with all the human experience that we bring. We built it to be inclusive and flexible for all situations. It was also designed to be highly adaptable for new features as AI develops exciting new capabilities.

We have over 19,000 tests that help us move fast; that translates to high quality software for our users and new features as they become possible. And we hope some of these new feature suggestions will come from our subscribers.

We truly hope to know our users; we built in communication features like our community
